none: PAS NLM-320A66: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian from near Market Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian, Securitas Rei Publicae issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Head diademed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS] REI P[VBLICAE]. Diameter: 16.0mm, Weight: 1.57gms, die axis: 6
